channel.title: Flicx: just added
channel.description: The films that arrived in the library last.

item.title: Near Dark (1988)
item.description: A small-town farmer's son reluctantly joins a traveling group of vampires after he is bitten by a beautiful drifter.

item.title: The Legendaries (2026)
item.description: They are brave, intrepid, indomitable, and they turned back to children! While fighting the terrible sorcerer Darkhell, the official heros of Alysia: The Legendaries accidentally broke the Jovenia stone, the one of eternal youth. This is how the whole kingdom of Alysia, and especially our champions, has fallen back into childhood. No more birth, but people keep on dying of accident or sickness… Humanity is then doomed to extinction. A real curse! And quite a blow to the myth of "The Legendaries". The five warriors, formerly admired, have now to lie low… Today blamed and discredited, they are well decided to break the spell and fix their mistake. "Nothing is impossible for a willing heart"… Even at 10!

item.title: Once (2007)
item.description: A modern-day musical about a busker and an immigrant and their eventful week in Dublin, as they write, rehearse and record songs that tell their love story.

item.title: Clean (2022)
item.description: Tormented by his past, a garbage man named Clean attempts a quiet life of redemption. But, soon finds himself forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.

item.title: The World to Come (2021)
item.description: Somewhere along the mid-19th century American East Coast frontier, two neighboring couples battle hardship and isolation, witnessed by a splendid yet testing landscape, challenging them both physically and psychologically.

item.title: The Prophecy (1995)
item.description: Gabriel and other angels jealous of humanity wage war using a police detective and the soul of a Korean War veteran.

item.title: Purple Noon (1960)
item.description: Tom Ripley is a talented mimic, moocher, forger and all-around criminal improviser; but there's more to Tom Ripley than even he can guess.

item.title: Open Season 2 (2008)
item.description: After falling head over hooves in love with Giselle, Elliot's road to the altar takes a slight detour when Mr. Weenie is 'kidnapped' by his human owners. A rescue mission starts. Oh, and there's also a group of pampered pets.

item.title: Monster Family 2 (2021)
item.description: The Wishbone Family transforms into monsters again to rescue Baba Yaga and Renfield from Monster Hunter Mila Starr. With their pet bats, they travel globally, make monster friends, and learn imperfection is okay.

item.title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018)
item.description: A villain's maniacal plan for world domination gets in the way of the Teen Titans' dream of superhero stardom in Hollywood.

item.title: The World Will Tremble (2025)
item.description: The incredible, untold true story of how a group of prisoners attempt a seemingly impossible escape from the first Nazi death camp in order to provide the first eyewitness account of the Holocaust.

item.title: Vertical Limit (2000)
item.description: A climber must rescue his sister on the peak of K2, the second highest mountain in the world.

item.title: Bambi II (2006)
item.description: The story of Bambi growing up in the care of his father, The Great Prince of the Forest.

item.title: Max (2015)
item.description: A military dog that helped American Marines in Afghanistan returns to the United States and is adopted by his handler's family after suffering a traumatic experience.

item.title: The Burning (1981)
item.description: Abusive former summer camp caretaker Cropsy, horribly burned from a prank gone wrong five years earlier, lurks around upstate NY summer Camp Stonewater with garden shears and bent on killing the teenagers responsible for his disfi...

item.title: Tron (1982)
item.description: A computer hacker is abducted into a digital world and forced to participate in gladiatorial games where his only chance of escape is with the help of a heroic security program.

item.title: Stand and Deliver (1988)
item.description: A teacher at an inner-city high school is convinced that his students have the potential to pass AP Calculus.

item.title: The Tenant (1976)
item.description: A bachelor man rents a Parisian apartment whose previous tenant committed suicide, and slowly finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.

item.title: Big Momma's House 2 (2006)
item.description: An FBI agent reprises his disguise as a corpulent old lady and takes a job as a nanny in a crime suspect's house.

item.title: Seed of Chucky (2004)
item.description: Chucky and Tiffany are resurrected by their innocent gender-confused child, Glen/Glenda, and hit Hollywood, where a movie depicting the killer dolls' murder spree is underway.

item.title: Pay It Forward (2000)
item.description: A young boy attempts to make the world a better place after his teacher gives him that chance.

item.title: Break In (2023)
item.description: A woman recently separated from her wealthy husband is terrorized during one harrowing night when a masked intruder breaks into her home. Is it a random home invasion or is something more malicious and personal going on?

item.title: Poison Ivy (1992)
item.description: A seductive teen befriends an introverted high school student and schemes her way into the lives of her wealthy family.

item.title: American Pie Presents: The Book of Love (2009)
item.description: Ten years after the first American Pie movie, three new hapless virgins discover the Bible hidden in the school library at East Great Falls High.

item.title: Steven Universe: The Movie (2019)
item.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

item.title: Below Her Mouth (2017)
item.description: An unexpected affair quickly escalates into a heart-stopping reality for two women whose passionate connection changes their lives forever.

item.title: Deleter (2022)
item.description: An online content moderator deletes a suicide video made by her co-worker. But the otherwise desensitized woman cannot escape from either her own troubled past or from a mysterious vengeful presence.

item.title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)
item.description: A Korean-American office worker and his Indian-American stoner friend embark on a quest to satisfy their desire for White Castle burgers.

item.title: The Last Stand of Ellen Cole (2024)
item.description: Follow a nefarious land developer who gets more than he bargained for when he tries to intimidate an 80-year-old widow into abandoning her Montana ranch.

item.title: Eraserhead (1978)
item.description: Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant child.

item.title: Chernobyl Diaries (2012)
item.description: Six tourists hire an extreme tour guide who takes them to the abandoned city Pripyat, the former home to the workers of the Chernobyl nuclear reactor. During their exploration, they soon discover they are not alone.

item.title: Jingle All the Way (1996)
item.description: A father vows to get his son a Turbo Man action figure for Christmas. However, every store is sold out, and he must travel all over town and compete with everybody else in order to find one.

item.title: The Bad Seed Returns (2022)
item.description: A new girl at school seems to know the secrets of Emma, who is anything but the typical teenage girl, so Emma must deal with her enemies by any means necessary.

item.title: Hollow Man II (2006)
item.description: A Seattle detective and a biologist are on the run from a dangerous invisible assassin gone rogue.

item.title: Superhost (2021)
item.description: With their follower count dwindling, travel vloggers Teddy and Claire pivot to creating viral content around their most recent "superhost," Rebecca, who wants more from the duo than a great review.

item.title: Smashed (2012)
item.description: A married couple whose bond is built on a mutual love of alcohol gets their relationship put to the test when the wife decides to get sober.

item.title: From Dusk Till Dawn (1996)
item.description: Two criminals and their hostages unknowingly seek temporary refuge in a truck stop populated by vampires, with chaotic results.

item.title: Titan A.E. (2000)
item.description: A young man learns that he has to find a hidden Earth ship before an enemy alien species does in order to secure the survival of humanity.

item.title: Light Light Light (2023)
item.description: Mariia visits her childhood home and reminisces about the summer of 1986, when a girl named Mimi arrived in the small village and filled the life of the then 15-year-old Mariia with light.

item.title: The Iron Lady (2012)
item.description: An elderly Margaret Thatcher talks to the imagined presence of her recently deceased husband as she struggles to come to terms with his death while scenes from her past life, from girlhood to British prime minister, intervene.

item.title: El Dorado (1967)
item.description: Cole Thornton, a gunfighter for hire, joins forces with old friend, Sheriff J.P. Harrah. Together with an old Indian fighter and a gambler, they help a rancher and his family fight a rival rancher who's trying to steal their water.

item.title: Six Days Seven Nights (1998)
item.description: Robin Monroe, a New York magazine editor, and the gruff pilot Quinn Harris must put aside their mutual dislike if they are to survive after crash landing on a deserted South Seas island.

item.title: Ashfall (2019)
item.description: Stagnant since 1903, at an elevation of 2,744 m, a volcano erupts on the mythical and majestic Baekdu Mountain.

item.title: EXIT (2019)
item.description: A former college climbing star struggles financially. At his mom's birthday party in his crush's workplace, he must use his climbing skills during a toxic gas emergency in Seoul.

item.title: Impractical Jokers: The Movie (2020)
item.description: The story of a humiliating high school mishap from 1992 that sends the Impractical Jokers on the road competing in hidden-camera challenges for the chance to turn back the clock and redeem three of the four Jokers.

item.title: Daniel Isn't Real (2019)
item.description: A troubled college freshman, Luke, suffers a violent family trauma. He then resurrects his charismatic childhood imaginary friend Daniel to help him cope, not realizing how dangerous Daniel is.

item.title: How High 2 (2019)
item.description: A pair of stoners embark on a pot-fueled adventure through Atlanta to find their missing weed.

item.title: White as Snow (2019)
item.description: Claire works at her late father's hotel run by evil stepmother Maud. Maud's lover falls for Claire, sparking jealousy. Maud plots against Claire who finds refuge on a farm with "seven princes," breaking free from her strict upbrin...

item.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors (2019)
item.description: After security expert Ray Breslin is hired to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a Hong Kong tech mogul from a formidable Latvian prison, Breslin's girlfriend is also captured.

item.title: The Lodge (2020)
item.description: A soon-to-be stepmom is snowed in with her fiancé's two children at a remote holiday village. Just as relations begin to thaw between the trio, some strange and frightening events take place.
